notes.title: The 'Lights, Camera, Action Update' is here!
notes.content:
Hello Demigods: Update 1.06 called 'Lights, Camera, Action!' is finally here!

This update brings the awesome new LIV Creator Kit to Demigod, making it much easier to share exciting content from the game. We can't wait to see what you come up with!

It also adds a long requested feature: Power Color Customization! The Player tab in the menu now has a Powers section, where you can alter the colors (and some themes) of your power sets.

Here is the full list of updates:

 Added Power Color Customization in Player Settings
 Integrated LCK Camera
 Added deadzone controls for thumbsticks.
 Added ambient noise to City levels.
 Updated some VFX & sounds.
 Reduced overall memory load of game files.
 Added basic post processing (Bloom). Controls are in Visual Settings tab.
 Moved City Controls tab to Settings.
 Fixed sounds that stopped playing after a while.
 Fixed earth spikes not stabbing correctly.
 Fixed tracking issues with Flying enemies when not using Hunter mode.
 Fixed environmental VFX.
 Fixed webline colliders.
 Fixed issue where player's jump would get cancelled out.
 General bug fixes & performance enhancements

Become a superhero - or villain - in Project Demigod today!

notes.title: Armory Update
notes.content:
Hello Demigods!

Update 1.04 “Armory” is now live!

This one comes with a ton of new stuff, improvements, bug fixes, reworks, and more.

So there’s Bad News, and Good News:

The Bad News:
Unfortunately, due to performance, technical reasons, and the upcoming multiplayer update, the Time Control abilities had to be removed from the game, including Time Reversal and Super Slow Motion. These abilities were built on an old, deprecated system that was causing more harm than good at this point. For now, Time Control will still have the same increased movement speeds, wall running, and a slightly better time slow than normal.

The Time Control power set will be overhauled with new abilities in the future.

Now for the good news: all the new stuff!

 New Demigod Avatar
 Male Vigilante Avatar now has hair and a facemask.
 Weapon Mod Support. Melee weapons can now be created in the Demi-Mod SDK and uploaded to mod.io.
 New Utility Belt System:
    
     Weapons can now be slotted into a visible inventory at the player’s waist. This can be set to always on, disabled, only visible when power wheels are open, or only visible when the player’s hands are near the Utility Belt.
 Weapons can be assigned in the new Loadout Interface in the Player Menu
 Lose your weapon? No problem. By moving the hand over the utility belt and pressing trigger, you can spawn another weapon into the same slot.
 When grabbing a Pistol or Rifle, the Utility Belt’s ammo slot will switch to the correct magazine.
        
     New Weapons: Bow, Arrow, Explosive Arrow, Shock Arrow, Grappling Arrow, Extendable Staff, Assault Rifle, Demigod Pistol, Pistol Magazines, Light Hammer
 Added new Weapon Models for Pistol, Shield, Hammer, Sword, Baton
 Added new ability for Shield, 'Bounce':
    
     When charged and thrown, the shield will now bounce off of objects towards nearby enemies, or recalled to the player’s hand.
    
 Added new ability for Hammers: Recall:
    
     When charged and thrown, hammers can cause large knockback to enemies and then be recalled to the player’s hand.
    
 Fire Power Set’s Explosion Mode is now a charged hold and release to activate. You can hold/charge for up to 3 seconds for a more powerful blast.
    

Enemies

 Enemy Pistols and Rifles can now be dropped by enemies when defeated and used by the player.
 Updated Enemy Physics & Stats
 Upgraded Agent models
 Increased enemy bullet damage
 Improved enemy ability to deal knockback force to the player (if enabled in settings).


Other

 Improved performance of Traffic & Pedestrian Systems.
 Added over a dozen new destructible billboards to the game. (Thanks Testers!)


Experimental:
Basic Mantling

 When grabbing the top of a flat ledge, tapping the jump button will move the player to that point if nothing is in the way.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed issue where some avatar mod’s heads & hands would be off.
 Fixed issue where some mods wouldn’t be usable after downloading.
 Fixed issue where enemies would sometimes lose collision physics.
 Fixed issue where enemies wouldn’t react to physical hits, or would pop back into place.
 Lots and lots of minor bugs squashed.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.032
notes.content:
Hello Demigods!

Quick hotfix to address some minor issues. 

Changelog:

Fixed issue with Enemy Customization sometimes loading the wrong enemy mod.
Fixed issue with Insect Queen
Fixed issue with Flying Larvae
Fixed bug where larger enemies would get stuck in the “falling” or “get up” state.
Minor bug fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Demi-Mod Update
notes.content:
Avatar Mods Upgrade

 Added support for Avatar “Events”. Modders can now link player actions that will activate/deactivate events.
 Avatars can now be set up to shoot weblines from any point, and can now “grab” the webs in their hands.
 Avatar mesh renderers can now be individually enabled/disabled to allow for multiple props to be added and switched. 

Map Mods Upgrade

 Objects can now be climbable.
 Several destructible objects can now be added to a map mod: Destructible building, streetlights, statues, glass panels, billboards, and more.
 Basic destructible script can be added to objects to destroy them when enough damage is done.

Enemy Avatar Mod Support

 Enemy avatars can now be created in the SDK and used in game.
 Once imported through the mod browser, the enemy can take on the attacks, stats, and movement of almost any enemy type. A single model can be made into a Robot, Ninja, Flying Blaster, and more.

Updated Modding SDK

 Overhauled user interface.
 Automatic folder creation and file movement for ease of use.
 One file location for all built mods.
 Modders no longer have to delete/move files when creating multiple mods in a row.

Engine Upgrade

 Project Demigod has been upgraded to Unity version 2022.3.27, and converted to use the URP rendering pipeline.
 This was necessary for future updates, including multiplayer.

Other

 Hero Base has been updated.
 Fog has been added to a number of levels.
 Water Materials have been updated.
 Glass Materials have been updated.

notes.title: Giant Enemies Update Available Now!
notes.content:
Hi there, Demigods!

We’re super excited to launch our first major free content update! The Giant Enemies update introduces two massive monsters to take on in select maps. Trust us when we say, these guys are enormous. It’s a totally new way to play the game. 

See the update in action in the brand new trailer here:

[previewyoutube=nqRbP5hfne8;full][/previewyoutube]
Today’s update adds both the Insect Queen and Giant Mech enemies. They introduce a new dimension to Demigod’s physics-driven superhero combat, allowing you to web or fly around the arena, dodging attacks and bringing your opponents toppling down. To access them, you’ll need to head to specific maps and locate their Hero Events. 

The Giant Mech, for example, can be found as purple hero events in the park of the MC map and in a corner of the New Olympus maps.

Today’s update also adds new enemy IK improvements and updates to logic and functionality of existing enemy types to make for a more immersive combat experience. The Agent and Robot enemy types also have all-new character models to face off against, and there are updates to the enemy spawn system, lighting in the New Olympus level, and general bug fixes have been implemented.

Thanks for joining us on the journey so far. Make sure to check out our content roadmap for more info on what’s next for Demigod!

notes.title: Project Demigod 1.0 Available Now!
notes.content:
Hello Demigods!

Project Demigod 1.0 is now live on Steam! This update adds new Hero Events and performance upgrades. This means there are some features and settings that are temporarily removed. Another small update will be out in the coming weeks to restore these features as well as add some new content.

Unfortunately, we've encountered an issue with today's Steam release that's preventing mod.io integration from working. We're looking into it and will issue a fix as soon as possible.

Thank you all for your support, it means the world to me. Check out our new gameplay walkthrough below!

[previewyoutube=OcD28nhqhSc;full][/previewyoutube]

1.0 is just the start. There will be tons more content this year, as well a new roadmap for the future of the game.

notes.title: Project Demigod Release Date Announced!
notes.content:
Hello Demigods! 

The full release of Project Demigod is right around the corner! The game launches on February 1 at 10am PT/1pm ET/6pm GMT with a fresh update. This will introduce our Hero Events System and include some key performance improvements. Check out the latest version of the game in our most recent trailer:

[previewyoutube=gzg2jjuXXsk;full][/previewyoutube]

Rest assured that, while this update marks the end of Early Access, it's far from the end of our support for Project Demigod. We have a major content update arriving not long after launch, and we have plenty of other plans for the game in the weeks and months to come! For now, here's what to expect in the release version of the game:


Hero Events System: Take to the streets and tackle curated waves of enemies in specific locations.
Integrated Mod Support: Featuring a massive variety of user-made avatars. All accessible from the game’s integrated menu.
Optimized Performance: Improvements to the game’s overall performance result in a smoother, more immersive experience.
More Content To Come: An evolving roadmap of content is in the works, including the arrival of a brand new enemy type soon after launch.


We're also not changing the price of the game for this launch; it's still $19.99. 

Not long to go! We can't wait to share the release version of the game with you next week.

notes.title: Patch 0.24.2
notes.content:
Hello Demigods!

Patch 0.24.2 is uploading now!
This patch fixes several bugs and updates enemy stability and difficulty.


Changelog:


- Enemy stability and resistance has been improved, making them much less likely to fall over from small collisions, and increasing their overall strength. 
- Enemy blasts now deal slightly more damage.
- Player health reduced to 125.
- Added option to disable Manual Grappline Lines while flipping.
- Updated enemy spawn points so they’re much less likely to spawn on top of one another.

- Fixed Save System (NOTE: If your save files are still corrupted and settings do not save, open your Player Menu and go to Settings -> Reset Data, Reset All Data. Then restart your game. This should clear all corrupt data. 

- Fixed Player Settings not applying after changes.
- Fixed Traffic System on Quest.
- Fixed Earth Control activation.
- Fixed player not moving if using flight and grounded.

notes.title: Patch 0.24.1
notes.content:
Hello Demigods!

Patch 0.24.1 will be live very soon!
This patch adds Kicking, Manual Grappling weblines, and a ton of bug fixes and performance improvements.


Changelog:


- Added Basic Kicking. When enabled, click the left joystick to kick where the player is looking. (Note: Sprinting is now activated by pushing the left joystick twice in the direction you want to move)
- Added option for Kick Power Boost in settings. Default is 3.
- Added option for Manual Grappling. When enabled, player can move the right joystick up or down to extend or retract weblines.

- Avatar Mods and Map Mods will now automatically refresh when opened if you are already logged into Mod.io
- Added setting to disable power images when switching powers/abilities.
- Added option to enable/disable auto-turn when gliding.
- Improved overall UI performance.

- Fixed double-hand web zip. While holding a web with two hands that is attached to an object or enemy, hold grip + trigger with the lead hand and move it to web zip the object or enemy.
- Fixed grabbable buildings in New Olympus.
- Fixed destructibles not appearing in MC.
- Fixed scrolling in Mod Browser.
- Fixed bug where some players’ Settings would not save when changed.
- Fixed lighting issue in New Olympus and Fog Hills
- Updated parts of New Olympus to load better on Quest 2.
- Fixed issue with Fog Hills not loading on Quest 2.
- Fixed wall run activating on enemies.
- Fixed Spear grips.
- Fixes issues some users were having with avatar mods, saved settings, and level loading.

notes.title: Update 0.23 - “Where is my Super Suit?”
notes.content:
Hello Demigods!

Update 0.23 “Where is my Super Suit?”  will be live soon! Here’s what’s new:


Mod Support 1.0
Avatar Mods are now possible in Project Demigod.

Weapon Poses can be created and set in the SDK, but some of them are still off. I’ll be releasing a hotfix for this soon. 

Full, dynamic hand posing for climbable surfaces, enemy grabs, etc.

Release of “Project Demi-Mod”, the modding SDK. It is available on GitHub here. Instructions for using the SDK are here. I’ll create a video for instructions soon too.

Mod.io Integration with the Player Menu. It now has its own tab. You need to open this browser every time you start a new game session to load in your mods. 
Future updates will have drag & drop mod support as well, for offline and Nexus mods.

If setup correctly, the modded avatars will also work with color customization and the Save System. Note that some avatars are all 1 material so it isn’t possible to customize every part.

PCVR mods and Quest mods are different, and will NOT work on different platforms. Be sure you create/build/download the right ones.

New Dive Mechanic (Experimental)
Player can now dive by looking directly at the ground and clicking the Right Joystick. Click it again to return to normal orientation.
Can be enabled/disabled in Settings.

New Manual Recovery Mechanic
With all of the crazy physics, acrobatics, and movement modes, the player body can get out of its normal orientation. Manual Recovery lets you return to normal orientation by bringing your left hand near your head and clicking the Left Joystick. 
Can be enabled/disabled in Settings.


Future updates will include Mod Support for Maps, Enemies, and more.

Finally, a quick personal note: many of you already know that I was hospitalized a few weeks ago. I was diagnosed with an auto-immune disorder that causes waves of fatigue, dizziness, nausea, etc. I’ve been getting better with treatment, but it took a lot out of me, so I wasn’t able to work on the game anywhere near as much as I wanted. This update isn’t the most polished, and I’m sure some bugs will happen, but I’ll push a small update for the game in a couple weeks, along with improvements to the SDK.

notes.title: Update 0.22 - "Infusion"
notes.content:
Hello Demigods!

Update 0.22 “Infusion” will be uploaded very soon!

Quick Release Notes: 

Like previous updates, this update introduces a ton of small changes to different systems, as well as some new experimental features, so expect some bugs (especially with the Kunai Teleport ability and the Procedural Levels)


The new avatar materials add interesting effects for the avatar, but be aware that not all of them can have their colors changed, some only work on armor and not on skin, and the Texture Enabled option doesn’t affect them. (This is due to the nature of the shaders that create the effects.)

Advanced Mode for Wall Running can be activated by either Pressing the Jump Button while moving towards a wall, or set to Continuous for those who want seamless changes while moving. This can be changed in the Player Menu.


New settings have been added, including Web Power, Smoke Trail VFX, etc. Be sure to look through those.

I’ll be back at it soon and I’ll have a hotfix out later this week, and then I’ll be hard at work on Update 0.23, which will introduce the first supported Mods: Avatars!

So much more to come!
- LvlUpHero

notes.title: Hotfix 0.21.1
notes.content:
Hello Demigods!

Hotfix 0.21.1 will be uploaded soon!
This update addresses a few bugs and rendering issues from Update 0.21, and adds a few small tweaks.


- Fixed Dragon Spawning. They now appear right next to you anytime you activate them.
- Fixed bug where enemies would not get up after being thrown or knocked out.
- Adjusted materials & shaders for Quest version.
- Fixed lighting on Quest version.
- Fixed texture compression settings for performance.
- Fixed performance issue on Quest version relating to the game engine’s static flags.
- Fixed performance issue on PCVR version relating to Multi-Pass being enabled instead of Single Pass Instanced.
- Fixed issue with destructible buildings not rendering correctly when loading Training Grounds or Fog Hills maps.
- Fixed a few bugs that may have been the cause of the crash when hitting enemies.
- Increased damage and knockback on the Water Whip.
- Lowered the pull when using grappling webs.
- Added code to check against some null errors.
- Tweaked settings for enemies.

- I have also added an option in Settings -> Visuals to turn on realtime lighting for a specific map. This only affects the CURRENT map you are loaded into. While this improves visuals and adds realtime shadows, only enable it if your headset can handle it.
- The options for this are No Shadows, Hard Shadows (blocky shadows), and Soft Shadows.
- I will add better lighting options and the ability to save this in the next update/hotfix.

notes.title: Early Access Update 0.21, AKA “LEVIATHAN”
notes.content:
Hello Demigods!

Early Access Update 0.21, AKA “LEVIATHAN” will be live on App Lab, Steam, and Itch.io as soon as the upload is complete!

It’s got TWO new enemies, an upgraded combat system, performance boosts, and a brand new Power Set… 

WATER CONTROL

Plus a few updates to the Fire Power Set!

Lots of exciting stuff is planned for Project Demigod in 2023, and I can’t wait to show you. So much more to come!


As always, there will be bugs. I believe I've taken care of any and all major bugs like crashes and performance hits, but the more complicated the game gets, the higher likelihood if some sneaking in. 
If there are any major ones left, I'll have a hot fix out asap. 

Otherwise I'll try to fix as many as possible over the next few days and do a minor hot fix then. 

Enjoy!



Change Log:

Added new Power Set: Water Control
Water Projectiles - While holding Grip and Trigger, pull back and then punch forward to fire a water orb that explodes on contact.
Water Whip - A flexible, extending stream of water that flows with your hands’ movements.
Water Dragon - Summon a dragon and control its movement. Strike enemies, launch Water Projectiles, or grab enemies and objects.
Typhoon Flight - Use a whirlwind of water to propel yourself through the air.

Fire Power Set:
Added Fire Dragon
Added Explosion Jump
Added new VFX for fireball and explosions.
Increased Damage and Knockback

Blaster Power Set
Laser Bolt is now a 3-count auto blast.
Increased damage.

Improved Grab System
Updated grab/release code that improved several areas including Super Strength and Stretch Grabbing.

New Enemy: Titan Monster
The Titan Monster is much stronger, and more durable than previous enemies. It utilizes its size, strength, and hard carapace to deliver crushing blows. Some of these attacks can cause shockwaves.

New Enemy: Bio-Mutants
Bio-Mutants use fast, quadrupedal movement and attack with vicious claws.

Combat AI System Upgrade
A new system has been created that improves overall combat. 
Enemies are now much better at aiming some of their physical attacks.
Enemies now choose appropriate attacks based on target distance. 
Enemy attack collisions now deal appropriate levels of damage to the player.
This system will continue to be updated to make combat even better.

New Enemy Animations
Several enemies have been given new attack animations and ranged options.

New Occlusion System
A new asset has been integrated that should give a decent performance boost for all levels, as well as fix some of the bugs with rendering destructible buildings and pedestrians.

Added new VFX and Audio Updates

Options
Added flip duration to Save System.
Added option to disable acrobatics during flight.
Added Shuffle button to Music Player.


Bug Fixes
Fixed issues with Vive Wands and most WMR controllers input.
Fixed bugs that could cause a crash when using Time Slow and opening the menu.
Fixed health bar rendering issue.
Fixed minor save system issues.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.20.1
notes.content:
Hello Demigods!

Hotfix 0.20.1 is now live on Steam and AppLab!

I’ll probably do another hot fix after the holidays to address any extra bugs and/or tweak some power settings, and then start working on Update 0.21, which will have a brand new Power Set, new content, and upgrades to the enemy combat AI.

Happy Holidays, and thank you for an incredible year. I can’t wait to show you all what I have planned for 2023!

Added Slow Motion Controls during acrobatics.

Added joystick controls for Menu scrolling.
Added Options for Targets Always Enabled, and options for Holsters.
Climbing should now be smoother and less jittery.
Fixed enemies not taking damage from collisions.
Fixed enemy health bars not always displaying correctly.
Cars should no longer revert to a heavier mass when letting go with one hand, but still holding on with the other. Also fixed bug when grabbing with both hands simultaneously.
Fixed most of the odd pedestrian behavior, including the female pedestrian disappearing when ragdoll’d.
Fixed options for Traffic and Pedestrians.
Fixed Save System for Settings and Avatar.
Fixed Menu Positioning bug due to old save data.
Added safety checks for Left Hip Holster.
Added new UI for latest changes in Hero Cave to explain controls and new mechanics.
Updated lighting and Light Probes in Millennium City.

notes.title: Update 0.20 VIGILANTE
notes.content:
Hello Demigods!

Update 0.20 VIGILANTE is here!

It should be live on Steam and Quest, just as soon as the upload is complete.

So much has been upgraded and changed, Enemy Difficulty Settings, the new Cave Base, User Interfaces, and the new Acrobatics mechanic! Almost every system has been improved for usability and performance. A huge thank you to all the players, those who gave feedback and bug reports in the Discord, and especially my Testing and Mod team! 

Quick Change Log:

Added Basic Pistols (Unlimited Ammo, no reloading needed)
Added Acrobatics Mechanic
Added female vigilante and ability to switch between avatars.
New Superhero Base/Cave. Dev Test area moved to Training Grounds.
New shiny menus and interfaces, plus more options.
Difficulty Setting for Enemies.
Enemies can block and dodge sometimes.
Webs are cooler, and more performant.
Healing and Vision are gone.
Cars act better and don’t get lost as much.
Millennium City is now one solid level.
New Pedestrians and better ragdolls for them.
Performance improvements across the board.


New Changes
Cars can now be damaged (deformed) by lasers and projectile blasts.
You can flip sideways as well (Barrel Roll) by tilting your head towards the side you want to roll and then flicking the joystick quickly in that direction.
Upgraded strength levels for almost all powers.
Added a small shader effect to Millennium City grass & hills for the holidays!


Because there are so many changes, there are sure to be a few bugs here and there.
On top of that, a program I use decided to crash my entire system over the last few days, so I didn’t get to put the finishing touches on a handful of things. These are almost entirely just about visuals and small tweaks. I’ll be working on a hotfix ASAP and will have it out in the next few days!


The hotfix this week will include fixes for:
Any bug reports, especially those dealing with Enemies or the Acrobatics mechanic.
Female Avatar hand poses when grabbing weapons.
Millennium City and Fog Hills lighting and building colors.
Player Menu options.
Pedestrian glitches.

notes.title: 0.19 (the "Fight Me in the Sky!" update)
notes.content:
Hello @Demigods!

For those who didn’t know, I became very sick and could barely get out of bed, much less finish up the final stuff for builds: light bakes, nav meshes, occlusion bakes, etc. So my schedule got messed up and I had to finish what I could. 

So the build is now out, but it’s a temporary build. I’ll have a hotfix out in the next day or two that will fix bugs, add the missing parts, and polish up a few things:
Quest 1 crashing when trying to load Fog Hills map.
Building color changes in MC.
Weird strength issues with Stretch Power Set.
Better controls/activation for the double hand blast.
Adjustments to Flying Enemy.
Performance stuff.
Bugs & stuff.


Til then, enjoy the update! This is just the start of the new flying enemies, I plan on having even more types as well as an updated fighting system too!

Let me know about bugs, opinions, etc in the discord!


I’m gonna go sleep for the next 12 hours and try to shake this thing off. Oh, and go check out Millennium City. Might be a couple changes there too, with more on the way…..

LvlUpHero

notes.title: Changelog & Notes for Early Access Update 0.16
notes.content:
Hello Demigods!

Early Access Update 0.16 is now live!

Thanks for your patience everyone! This isn't a big content update, but a ton of work has been put in to lay groundwork for the next few updates, fix bugs, rewrite older code, improve performance, research some new ways of improving the game, etc.

The new memory system hasn't been implemented just yet. There were some more underlying issues with the game engine I'm using that I believe have been fixed, but it took weeks just to find an answer. I'll be trying to get this system out next.


Here's the list of what's changed:


Major Changes:
- Added (Basic) Zombie Enemy Type
- Added Zombie Mode version of Pedestrian System
- Updated Pedestrian System with several bug fixes, animations, and logic.
- Traffic System Update
- Upgraded Webline Creation ability to work with held objects.
- Updated Strength Power Set to be more stable under heavy loads (vehicles)
- Strengthened Laser Vision Damage and Pushback
- Improved Webline Strength


Pedestrian System:
- Fixed bugs (and models) where pedestrians would disappear after being ragdoll'd.
- Fixed bugs where pedestrians would play wrong animations for their movement.
- Navigation system has been updated so that pedestrians stay on sidewalks.
- Pedestrians now react to (most) attacks on other nearby pedestrians by ducking or running away.
- More small updates coming soon, including new character models, performance updates, and more reactions.


Traffic System:
- Vehicles have been updated so that they should now very rarely tip over when turning too fast and should crash a lot less.
- Vehicles' mass has been increased to higher levels for better, more accurate physics.
- Semi Truck has been temporarily removed, as it was causing the majority of the traffic jams. It will be added back in once I fix the issue.

- Traffic System Performance: As it turns out, the vehicle system I've been using for Project Demigod is harder on performance than I originally thought. It has been much improved with this update, but I'm working on another system change that should drastically reduce the lag caused by all traffic.


New Player Options:
Don't like pedestrians crowding your city? Tired of traffic eating up your headset's performance? No problem! A new option is now available in your Player Menu called "City Controls", where you can: 
- Disable either system entirely (this really helps performance)
- Tweak the max amount of vehicles/people that can be active at a time.
- Turn off the pedestrian's physics, so you still get the feeling of the city being more alive without the cost of ragdolls anytime they get hit!

Millennium City
- Updates: The city may look a little different now, and it will continue to change over time. Some buildings have been replaced or updated, and the underlying city structure is now much more solid.
- Lighting and reflections have been updated.


Enemies:
- Zombies! 
- Finally found and fixed the bug that was causing enemy AI to only select certain attack animations. Many enemies should now have "new" attack animations during combat, such as different types of kicks, spins, weapon strikes, etc.


Other:
- Fixed bug that would set Turning Rotation Speed to 0 when switching out of Super Speed Power Set.
- Fixed weird grabbing behavior on the right hand that would create an offset for the grip position.
- Fixed bug where laser pointer wouldn't work after closing player menu and then re-opening.
- Fixed Taxi and Police Car not being grabbable.
- Fixed several small bugs with Pedestrians and ragdoll creation.

notes.title: Early Access Update 0.15 - Pedestrians
notes.content:
Hello Demigods!

Early Access Update 0.15 is now live on Steam and AppLab!

This update's big feature is the Pedestrian System 1.0!
Now, Millennium City has citizens walking around its streets to make the city feel much more alive. If that wasn't enough, they can also ragdoll when hit or attacked with a power, grabbed, thrown, webbed, blasted and more!

Keep in mind, this is just the 1.0 version. This means: 

- The system is a little bare-bones for now. But there is a LOT more to come now that the base code is in. More citizens, reactions, interactions, effects, etc are all in the works.

- There are still some glitches with the system, such as pedestrians who are "walking" but not moving, pedestrians who "teleport" back to their original position after being ragdolld, and the T-pose they move into when not activated up close. I'll be doing a hotfix sometime in the next week to address as many of these as I can.

- Not all powers, items, or collisions affect pedestrians. 

What does affect pedestrians:
- Collisions with Player
- Webs and Web Projectiles
- Web Lines (for attaching them to stuff)
- Fireballs and Explosions
- Laser Bolts
- Gravity Bombs
- Sonic Blasts
- Collisions with weapons
- Laser Vision
- Earth Projectiles and Earth Gauntlets
- Collisions with Vehicles
- Projectiles

What does NOT currently affect pedestrians:
- Time Control beams
- Flames
- Collisions with enemy ragdolls
- Collisions with other pedestrians
- Earth Columns

A future update will improve all of these issues, but for now, enjoy the new update!


Update Changelog:
- Pedestrian System 1.0 + Simple Ragdolls
- Basic Waypoint System for Pedestrian Navigation
- Added base code for future GPU Instancing features.
- Updated super-strength flight code to better check for movement vs braking.
- Fixed issue where holding vehicles caused odd physics, especially when using super strength to fly with or throw vehicles.
- Fixed bug where grabbing bullets in slow-motion could result in weird physics behavior by the bullet.
- Fixed issue where Healing power wasn't working.
- Added more checks to stop vehicles from getting stuck.
- Adjusted web power's zipline functions.
- Fixed more edge cases where Time Reversal would trigger extreme forces when ending.
- Fixed issue where mass changes were not being applied correctly to enemy ragdolls.
- Giant Robot should no longer change Super Strength amounts when grabbed.
- Aiming and IK has been adjusted for Shooter Agents
- Adjusted code for damage and force calculations.
- Reduced drag on some enemies when in slow-motion.
- New Memory System is still not implemented due to issues with Unity and Quest, but will be the main focus for the next update.
- Quest: increased distance grab "width" to make it a little easier to grab and pull weapons.

notes.title: Project Demigod Early Access - Update 0.14 - Laser Vision
notes.content:

Hello Demigods!
Update 0.14 is now live on Steam and AppLab!


This update introduces Laser Vision (by popular demand!) which has been added to the Super Strength power set. It’s brand new, so expect fixes and upgrades in future updates. 


Time Control has had a lot more polish, but it’s not perfect. There still may be some weird physics after freezing/rewinding enemies.

Finally, LOTS of polish has gone into bug fixing and laying the groundwork for the future. My first week of being a full time game-dev has been super productive, and I can’t wait to bring so much more to the game!

Quick note: a few bugs made it into the Quest version, so I’ll be fixing those and pushing another quick update later tonight or tomorrow at the latest. These mainly have to do with the Web power set feeling very weak, wall running input being backwards for left and right movement, and the enemies taking a much longer time than normal to get up after being ragdolled by the webs.



Change Log:

- Added Laser Vision ability to Super Strength Power Set. Currently, this ability will do damage and knockback to enemies and objects, including destructibles.
- Added new damage reaction animations when most enemies are hit with high amounts of force.
- Added new code to try and solve the calibration issues at start that made some players camera level start on the ground.

- Updated Time Slow when using Time Power Set: enemies and objects are now at 15% regular speed (down from 25%) and projectiles are now at 7% speed (down from 15%) 
- Updated Super Strength Flight to not stop the player when flying with triggers.
- Updated Power Wheels to solve incorrect selection.

- Fixed incorrect mass amounts for some enemies.

notes.title: The Demigod Update
notes.content:
Hello Everyone! 

First, if you haven't already noticed, we have a new name! (For pretty obvious reasons...) The game is now Project Demigod!

It's been a long while since the last update, but for good reason. Essentially, I spent months redesigning and upgrading the game and all of its systems.

The result....?


 Massive changes in performance and optimization.
 A new scene streaming system, which means the individual levels can now be as big as I can make them! 
 Using this new system, Millennium City is now 4x the size, but with better performance than the old one! And it's only going to get bigger.
 Destruction System overhaul: Massive performance increase and several more destructible objects, with more on the way!
 A brand new Traffic System using the Burst and Jobs systems for much better performance.
 Deformable Cars - All vehicles can be dented, crushed, and destroyed before exploding.
 Enemy Upgrades: AI, Special Attacks, and Spawning have all been improved.
 Power Set Upgrades: Try out the all new Earth Control power, or the new Webline Creation ability for the Web power set. 
 Training Grounds, Apartment Complex, and Ancient City have all been upgraded with better lighting, colliders, and graphics.



Part of the process also involved porting it for the Quest and Quest 2 (which is now available on AppLab!)

There's so much more to come, and I can't wait to show you everything I have planned for the future. This is only the beginning!

- LvlUpHero

notes.title: Early Access - Update 0.1
notes.content:
Update 0.1

It's finally here!
The first major update to Project META since the release of Early Access. There was a ton of really helpful feedback, and I've been working non-stop to improve every aspect of the game that I can. 

So here are the major highlights and changes:


 Hero Event - Combat: The first part of the new Hero Event System is ready! These are randomized enemy encounters that spawn from the red beams of light found in all levels. To use them, simply stand in the ring. Soon to come are other Hero Events such as Timed, Destruction, and Rescue Events.

 Enemy Weaponry: Agents, Ninjas, and the new Monks now have Melee Weapons equipped. When dropped, they can be picked up and used by the player.

 Web Power Set Upgrade: Web lines can now be connected between enemies, and objects, walls, ceilings, and more!  Web Projectiles will explode on collision, creating web strands at nearby objects. Use them to immobilize enemies, stick them to walls, or even each other!

 Blaster Power Set Upgrade: Nova Bombs have been converted to Gravity Bombs! These temporarily nullify the gravity of enemies and send them flying! Try using them with your other powers for some awesome physics combos.

 Blaster Power Set Upgrade: Lightning Orbs will now auto-correct their trajectory when fired at a metal enemy, drone, or an enemy already hit by a Lightning Sphere.

 Earth Control Power Set: Movement Pillars have been replaced with a Super Jump. Simply hold the jump button to charge, and release to blast off!

 New Enemies: Monks are masters of martial arts and energy-based attacks. They utilize weapons similarly to the Ninja.

  New (Experimental) Enemy: Raptors.  Raptors are the first of the non-humanoid ragdoll enemies. They will move, attack, and react to the player just as the humanoid ragdoll enemies do. (Note: this is a very new implementation and will need more work, but the basic functionality has been implemented and I wanted to let everyone try them out!)

 Millennium City Update: Lighting has been changed to Daytime based on player feedback. While I'm working on Day-Night cycles, there are still a few bugs to iron out before it's ready.

 All enemies have had improvements to AI, navigation, ranged attacks, and ragdoll physics.

 A ton of bug fixes, performance optimizations, and Input & Player Rig redesign to get the project ready for the eventual ports. 

 20 Japanese Metal music tracks have been added by the artist Audimus!  

 UI Updates and visual indicators for loading Enemy Waves and Level Selection.

 Finally, there will most likely have to be a rebranding of Project META due to obvious reasons. I'll make a post about it in the near future, but wanted to let everyone know about the eventual name change.

notes.title: Demo Update 4.2 and Next Fest!
notes.content:
Update 4.2 

Hello Everyone!

We're part of Steam's NEXT FEST! This is a full week where Steam gives back to the developers who have a free demo available to the public but have not yet released the game. It's an amazing chance to show the game to a much larger audience and I'm very grateful. 

Early Access is coming soon, and the game is growing by leaps and bounds all thanks to the community's feedback! 

Don't forget to join the Discord channel if you haven't already!
Project META Discord

Other than overall performance optimizations and tweaks, here are all of the noted changes:

Changelist for 4.2
[olist]
 Super Strength has been changed to increase different mass amounts of the avatar body. This should decrease pushback when striking and lessen the avatar being lifted off the ground when throwing. While still experimental, it seems to be helping a good deal with control and balance.
 Flight has also had an experimental change: Double clicking the triggers should greatly increase the acceleration of flight. A visual and audio effect will be added soon to make it much more apparent. 
 Hitting the ground at a high speed now produces a larger version of the force wave effect. It does not affect the player but should knock back enemies and objects in range.
 Web Zip-Lines are now MUCH more responsive. Players should be able to use it much more frequently and activate it more accurately.
 Each weapon slot is now automatically set to one of the 4 current weapons on start, instead of all being swords by default.
 Improved wind sounds and thresholds for activation.
 Fixed grabbing offset for some objects.
 Added more checks to cancel hover mode correctly. 
 More lighting Improvements! Light Probes added to all levels. What this means is that lighting on dynamic objects like your avatar, enemies, and moving objects should be MUCH better and change with their movement. 
 Layers have been changed so that the web lines do not interfere with the web projectiles.
 Fixed Music Controls not working after update.
 Fixed Max Debris Limit not working after update.
 Fixed Player Start Point being too high in apartment complex.
 Fixed missing Light Probes in Millennium City.
 Added controls for shadow quality.
 Added controls for Shadow Render Distance.
 Fixed Max Render Distance for Camera not working after update.
 Fixed Hover Mode still glitching after cancelling.
 Fixed impact decal getting destroyed after walls were broken.
 Fixed Web Projectile that was too weak after update. 
 Fixed enemy count that could be set to 0 on enemy spawner interface.
 Fixed Weapon Panel popping up after switching to new powerset.
 Fixed Popups disappearing too soon.
 Minor aesthetic and optimization changes to the superhero base in terms of the energy pulses throughout the architecture. 
 Super Strength glitch where turning off the power screwed up the body mass and dropped you through the floor has been fixed. 
 Enemy AI and FSM has been cleaned up and should be slightly more performant.
 Changed web effect.
 Added function to turn off trigger power when player menu is open.
 Level Select Images are now usable by laser pointer OR by physically touching the image.
 Improved enemy jump animations and AI. Should no longer jump during attacks. 
 Fixed and improved enemy navigation in Apartment Complex.
 More destructible objects are now grabbable.
 Fixed enemy spawn interface that had different spawn limits than the menu.
 Fixed menu calibration button in player menu.
 Added small auto-calibrate to start of game so player isn't auto-set so low.
 Fixed and improved crack VFX when doing hard landings.
 Fixed double fireball creation when using Fire Bomb. 
 Increased deacceleration of player when letting go of input to reduce drift. 
 Added more visual effects to player base.
 Opening the player menu while in slow-motion now uses same time-scale as normal time. 
 Vehicles have undergone a serious AI and optimization re-work and many bugs were fixed. 
[/olist]

notes.title: Demo Update #4 - Controls, Aesthetics, and Interfaces
notes.content:
Demo Update #4

As I get Project META ready for both Steam Next Fest (Oct. 1st) and Early Access (Oct. 8th), I've made several aesthetic and quality-of-life improvements for the game based on everyone's feedback. Project META is looking much better this time around, and has grown by leaps and bounds over the past few months. I'll be making much more frequent updates over the next few weeks to fix reported bugs, improve minor areas, and add options requested by the community.


Here's a look at this update:

Controls
[olist]
 Control scheme has changed considerably. Power Wheels are now individual and activated by holding the B Button on either controller. This affects the following powers detailed below.
 Blast Power Set: Double click the grip button to change Blast Type.
 Fire Power Set: Double click the grip button to Create a fireball.  Fire Breath has been taken out temporarily until better control scheme is found.
 Weapon Power Set: 4 Holsters have been placed around the body; 2 on the shoulders and 2 on the hips. These are where you can draw your weapons from now. 
 To set which weapons are in which holster, use the new Armory Interface.
[/olist]

Environments
[olist]
 Physical interfaces have been placed in every level. They have the same functionality as the player menu.
 Health and Energy levels have been moved to the right forearm instead of the HUD. 
 Gladiator Arena and Research Center have been added as levels in development. 
 Lighting improvements to all scenes, including ambient occlusion, more sources of baked light, and a switch to night time for Millennium City, as well as some minor prop/environment changes. 
 Light Probes have been added to all levels. What this means is that lighting on dynamic objects like your avatar, enemies, and moving objects should be MUCH better and change with their location. 
[/olist]

Interfaces
[olist]
 Interface's are another way to interact with the system, and most support both touch-based and laser pointer controls.
 Level Select, Avatar Calibration, Armory Interface for the Weapons Power Set, and Enemy Wave Spawner all have separate Interfaces that will be available in every level.
 
[/olist]

Other 
[olist]
 Several bugs and sub-optimal code was removed and the game is running smoothly.
 Vibrations have been added to more collisions and weapon strikes.
 Help texts have been updated to match the new control schemes.
 Wave options have been disabled while a wave is in progress so that mid-fight changes won't mess up the spawning logic. 
[/olist]

notes.title: Project META Demo Update #3 is Live!
notes.content:
Project META - Demo - Update #3


This is Update #3 for the Project META Demo! 
There is so much that has been updated, improved, and optimized. Mountains of quality of life changes and bug fixes have gone into this one. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722537/eb7718acb1b63fa49b6b270f2b1e2b8fef4768b9.png

I'll start with the biggest changes:

Enemies - Optimizations and new Enemy Types

 This may be the largest change in the Update. Enemies have been optimized A LOT, and perform much better than in the last few iterations.
 Enemies no longer hit the player's body when they are knocked out or set the player's movement off-course.
 Enemy movement, combat, recovery, and overall physics have been largely improved, and they should feel much more "natural" in terms of balance and resistance.
 Three new enemy types have been added as mid-bosses for the Agents enemy set: Stone, Stretch, and Steel. These are powered versions of the original agents, and should make combat a little more interesting. More of these will come in future updates!



New Level: Training Grounds
That's right, we finally have a training area to practice movement, powers, combat, and traversal!
This level has a little bit of everything, including destructible objects, prototypes of future items, moving and non-moving targets, and a few vehicles.
It will be updated over time to include even more!


All 3 levels have been updated and improved:

 Asian City and Apartment Complex have both almost doubled in size, had their lighting improved, and several interactable objects have been added.
 Millennium City has had several of its buildings replaced or moved around for a much better feel to the environment.



Power Redesign: Lasers -> Blaster Power Set
The punch-lasers were fun, but by far the least popular power set. So I stripped it completely and redesigned it from the ground up as the Blaster power set. 
This is much more intuitive to use, and adds some more frenetic shooting action to the game that wasn't there before. There are 4 Blast types so far:
[olist]
 Energy Bolt - A basic blast of energy. While low on damage and force, its low cost means it can be used repeatedly.
 Lightning Orb - Less speed and more cost than the Energy Bolt, but the lightning orbs have a greater change of temporarily disabling enemies. Useful for crowd control.
 Nova Bomb - Slower and more costly than the other Blast types, but by far the most damaging. Also causes decent force for knocking back enemies.
 Sonic Blast - This concentrated wave of sound does decent damage, and causes the most force against enemies. It also applies much more damage to objects and structures.
[/olist]


Power Update: Webs
This power set has been changed pretty extensively, with the biggest one being that in order to zip-line (whether yourself to a static objects, or an enemy to you) you now need 
to hold the grip button as well. This solves the issue of accidentally zip-lining yourself when you only wanted to swing, or pulling an item much faster than you meant to. 


Power Update: Super Strength
Hovering: this powerset now has a Hover mode that can be activated by releasing both of the triggers and then pressing the Jump button. This immediately slows the player to a stop.
Pulling the triggers again will deactivate Hover mode.


Power Update: Fire
The fireballs now cause a large amount of force damage when they explode, knocking back enemies, items, and debris. 


Power Update: Weapons
Weapons have had all around optimizations, including audio, despawning, handling, and throwing. 


Music
More tracks have been added to the player's music controller. A better and easier to use system will come in a future update.


UI: Options and Updates
Options have been added for: Invincible Enemies, maximum debris amount, camera rendering distance, and more. 
UI has been updated and improved for performance.

notes.title: Demo Update #2: Super Strength and Flight!
notes.content:
Super Strength! Flight! Destructible Objects! Level Updates!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722537/ccc9ce7fe5b3f4fd9dcaebe3e33de314a673a0ca.png


Below is a list of the largest changes.

Updates

1. Power Sets: Added Super Strength and Flight, plus Web and Laser Re-works
	a. Player now has an "Ultimate" Power Set that increases strength and durability, allowing the player to lift and throw heavy objects and deal greater damage and force to enemies.
	b. Player also gains a fist-based directional flight, activated by pointing the fists in the chosen direction and pulling the main triggers.
	c. This power set has been added to both power selection wheels as a blank circle labeled "Ultimate".
	d. Web Power Set has been reworked. Instead of pressing the grip button to zip-line, you now use a hand movement away from the point where your web line has attached. This also works for objects and enemies. 
The harder your pull in the opposite direction, the more powerful the pull. Still needs a lot of tweaking/balancing, but for now it feels pretty good.
	e. Laser Powerset has not only been fixed, but there is now an option in the player menu to switch from punch-based activation to a simple charge-hold activation. 
The laser effects have also been optimized for better performance.

2. Graphics Upgrade
	a. Player Avatar, objects, environments, and some power-sets have been updated to a higher graphic quality. 
	b. Jagged edges in levels have been greatly reduced.
	c. Apartment Complex and Ancient City have undergone some changes to improve the environments.
	d. UI aesthetic changes in the player menu.


3. General Gameplay Additions
	a. Vehicles are now grabbable/throwable, but still have the same weight/physics. The new super-strength feature will help with this. This is a brand new feature, and still needs to be fine-tuned. Different vehicles have different weights, and will respond accordingly.
	b. Rotation Speed can now be changed in the Settings Tab of the Player Menu.
	c. Rotation Speed has been increased by a large amount when using slow-motion ability.
	d. Destructible objects have been added to Apartment Complex and Ancient City.
	e. Options have been put into basic categories, there were too many to fit on one screen anymore.
	f. Basic Aerial Combat Drones have been added to the enemies list.
	


4. Optimizations
	a. Tons of code optimizations for better performance.
	b. Many more items are now using Object Pooling instead of creation/deletion.
	c. Items not in player area are being disabled/turned down to save on performance.


5. Bug Fixes
	a. Fixed bug that would cause multiple zip-line pulls instead of a single pull.
	b. Fixed spawning issue with enemies that would cause no enemies to appear.
	c. Fixed bug where enemies abilities would stay on after teleporting.
	d. Fixed bug where enemies stayed "knocked out" instead of recovering.
	e. WMR Controllers should now be able to open the menu by using the Menu button instead of the Right Thumbstick Press.
	



Current Known Bugs
1. Player has tendency to get hands stuck behind walls. Working on a fix/reset for this.
2. Drones can sometimes get stuck behind large walls when pathfinding. Updating to a better navigation system soon. 
3. Giant Robot gets stuck on small spaces like the stairways in the Apartment Complex.
4. Web-Zip and Super Strength still need a lot of tweaking to feel "right."

notes.title: Project META: Update #1: Weapons and Enemy Upgrades
notes.content:
Project META has its first (demo) update! Weapons, Enemy Upgrades, and a ton of general improvements and bug fixes!

1. Weapons: This update reworks the Energy Weapons Power Set into the Summon Weapons Power Set. Currently, the available weapons are Sword, Shield, Kunai, and Spear.

	a. Weapons and objects can be force grabbed from a short distance away, even when impaled into objects and enemies. 
	b. Bladed Weapons like the Sword, Kunai, and Spear can be stabbed into enemies and objects and cause more damage than regular hits, but create less force and knockback than Blunt Weapons like Shields or Punches.
	c. Blunt Weapons like the shield cause more knockback force on enemies, but can't stab into objects or enemies. 
	d. Be aware that this is a brand new implementation and still requires a LOT of testing and bug-fixes until it's stable. 
	e. Many more weapon types will be available in the full game!


2. Enemy Updates: All enemies have been given an update and are now tougher, more optimized, modular, and have a few new tricks.

	a. All enemies now have a limited teleport ability when they are unable to reach the player, such as when on the roof of a tall building or if they become stuck behind walls.
	b. All enemies have been given a boost in terms of damage and collision resistance. This should make combat at least a little more challenging.
	c. Ninja Enemies can now dodge, disappear, have more martial arts attacks, and have a few new special abilities.
	d. Ninja Movement has been.....improved?
	e. Robot Enemies have an increased range with their flamethrowers and laser vision, and their aim has been improved.


3. Sound Effects: Weapons and objects now have varied sounds and collision effects when hitting specific objects or enemies. 

	a. Weapons will spark and use metal-on-metal sounds when hitting hard, metal objects or robot enemies.
	b. Weapons will use metal-on-flesh sounds when hitting human enemies like the agents and ninjas.
	c. Note: These sounds are just the first iteration, and will be updated/replaced in future updates.


4. General Gameplay Additions

	a. Added options for "Unlimited Enemies" which will continuously spawn enemies when one is defeated without restarting or switching to a new wave.
	b. Added options for "Unlimited Waves" which will still use the X enemies per wave format, but will keep creating new waves.
	c. Added volume control for music player.
	d. Added many more spawn locations for enemies in Millennium City.
	e. Updated Info Tab of Player Menu with new descriptions for power re-works, images that correspond with power sets, and clearer instructions.
	f. Update Power Wheel to show names of powers, and added new image for Web Power Set to match the others.
	g. Added Targets to Superhero Base to practice stabbable weapons.
	

PLUS! Some awesome new concept art for a future character!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722537/de0f6fbf521f446d9d2ddb6bd9a15528ac511a21.png


Optimizations
	a. Added LOD's to enemies to reduce CPU load when enemies are at far distances.
	b. Added LOD's to more buildings as well.
	c. Added functionality to reduce unnecessary poly's on Agent enemies.
	d. Pistol Agents and Rifle Agents have been merged into one single enemy type: Agent Shooters. This will be a small memory improvement for now, but huge later on when more shooter types are introduced.
	e. Various code optimizations.


Bug Fixes
	1. Fixed an error where enemies would not despawn when pressing the Cancel Scenario button in the Player Menu.
	2. Fixed bug that could possibly cause an error with loading levels.
	3. Fixed bug where LOD's would cause enemies to disappear entirely.
	4. Added more safeguards against falling outside of the play area which would make the player have to restart.
